# GNCore

GNCore is a Python CLI and skill catalog. Skills are instructions for AI assistants, not independently executing agents.

- Home: https://gncore.pages.dev/
- All 403 skill pages: https://gncore.pages.dev/all-skills/
- Use-case guides: https://gncore.pages.dev/use-cases/
- Installation (Windows, macOS, Linux): https://gncore.pages.dev/download/
- Creator (Paladugu Ganesh Naidu): https://gncore.pages.dev/creator/
- Public source: https://github.com/paladuguganeshnaidu/gncore
- Package: https://pypi.org/project/gncore/
- License: https://github.com/paladuguganeshnaidu/gncore/blob/main/LICENSE
